q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of building a bus body?
title: Bus body building carbon footprint
short: Weigh the steel or aluminium sections, panels, glass, seats and paint bought for each body and apply supplier or secondary factors. Add the workshop's welding power, paint booth fuel and compressed air. The chassis is a separate purchase; report it as its own line.

ul: Structure: steel tube or aluminium extrusion, by weight bought.

p: Take monthly electricity and fuel, multiply by their factors, and divide by bodies completed that month.

senseible: Senseible reads your electricity bills, fuel invoices and purchase invoices into dated, fingerprinted records, so a per unit footprint can be traced back to the documents behind it. Estimates are labelled as estimates.

sources.label: GHG Protocol Corporate Value Chain (Scope 3) Standard
